sha: SET-AT-LAUNCH: branch ore-tunnel (a63b93d on inventory-hygiene/last-swing) rebased onto the fleet sha at launch; digsync must already be on the fleet (the tunnel stalls on ghost blocks without it)
notes: OWNER 2026-09-29: 'use both engines to design, implement, build and deploy the best approach to mining; check if the bots have pickaxes, if not, that should be a priority before mining.' Anti-xray is off on every world, so bots see iron in loaded chunks (median nearest 15 blocks); iron failed as 'every candidate is buried' (474 of 483 iron gather rows failed in 5.6 h on 09-29; 2 succeeded). THE CHANGE: gather escalates a buried iron target to a planned staircase tunnel (pathfinder over a tunnel profile: dig allowed, no parkour/towers/diagonals/1x1 shafts, drops <= 1) under hazard masks (liquid/waterlogged/unknown faces, falling blocks, lavaguard's cell + drop tests = the corridor guard's, home radius), accepted only on status success and checked on arrival; a pickaxe budget whose refusal adopts a stone_pickaxe with THIS trip's uses as the task (chain property-tested); gather's rescan collects. Design (iron-research-2026-09-29.md) and implementation reviewed by Claude and Codex independently; both REJECTED the first implementation; every finding fixed (a63b93d). 21 tests; mutants killed; 206/206. SANDBOX Paper 1.21.11: buried ore 6/6 reached and collected; gravel ceiling and water above collected; worn pickaxe refused with the right remedy; lava wall reached but collectblock returned without collecting (the fleet's existing 8.8% 'collect threw nothing' -- a known limitation). A/B on the ghost-making harness: see STATE. A CAPABILITY change: the outcome line gates KEEP (>= 1 ore collected on the canary; baseline ~0.015/bot-h).

licence.note: The baseline has no `_ore_tunnel` kind. Iron attempts run ~3.4 per bot per 2.6 h in control, so a pool that asks for iron writes tunnel rows within the first read.

require.name: bots asking for iron (the population the tunnel serves)

draw_exposure.note: Dry run: hive-c wrote 6 iron gather rows in 2.6 h against 255 on 75 control bots; min 10 keeps a pool that rarely asks for iron from being drawn.

exposure.note: Ready = >= 3 canary tunnels AND control iron gather rows >= 1.

own_lines.note: HARM, the two-death floor applied to deaths within 120 s after a tunnel row (the deaths this change can cause). One is reported and named, not a verdict (OWNER 2026-09-11).
A bot refused pickaxe_short 6+ times in the window means the adopted remedy is not unlocking the trip -- the loop both reviews found and the chain test forbids.
OUTCOME: the tunnel yields iron on the fleet. BLOCKS KEEP (INCONCLUSIVE), never reverts.
POSITIVE CONTROL (255 in the dry run). BLOCKS KEEP.

primary.note: Iron ore collected per bot-hour, DiD vs the same-length pre-window (baseline control 0.005-0.015). Immobile bot-hours and the stuck/entombment rows come from immobiledid; a rise in bots immobile below y=60 is read by hand at every read.

harm.note: Unchanged: the two-death floor (OWNER 2026-09-11) and gather_ratio < 0.43 of control, from immobiledid.

teardown.note: THREE STEPS: drop-ins, clear canary_pool, restart the pool's bots 12 s apart; then confirm the live versions.

extension.note: A capability, not a fix: the standard 26 h with reads at 3/6/12 h, extended until >= 3 canary tunnels.
